sections.heading: Why ASTROASCEND?
sections.body: Humans stand at the top of every other species — not only because of our immense understanding of nature, but because of how we constantly update and create new things to meet our needs. That knowledge deserves to be shared with children who are eager to learn, and that is exactly what AstroAscend does.

sections.heading: What is ASTROASCEND?
sections.body: AstroAscend is an educational platform dedicated to providing comprehensive and innovative learning experiences. Our curriculum extends beyond traditional school subjects, delving into the underlying mechanics of each topic and exploring relevant extracurricular contexts.

columns.body: AstroAscend is a company that believes in peer teaching. People tend to listen and learn better when they can connect with their teacher, and in changing times — where a new ideology emerges every five years — only students can truly connect with other students.

Being run by students is a huge undertaking — both for those still learning and those who already have. AstroAscend is committed to delivering knowledge to every person, no matter how much of a master of the subject they already are.

AstroAscend believes in an environment-first policy. Every person who joins us is issued a pledge to serve and protect Mother Earth from all threats. The nature of the human race is not to destroy, but to save and protect — that is what we stand for, and that is what we stand by.

columns.heading: Vision
columns.body: To build a group of heart-awakened leaders who are not only excellent at academics, but are also awakened to the real world through consciousness and creativity.

columns.heading: Mission
columns.body: To connect with students one-on-one and teach each person at their own pace — creating trailblazers for the greater good, for a better tomorrow.

header.title: Master Classes
header.subtitle: Master Your Craft, Master Your Passion.

courses.title: Astronomy
courses.description: Gain hands-on experience in astronomy. Learn from experts, explore the night sky, and contribute to research projects. Perfect for aspiring astronomers and science enthusiasts. Start a conversation on the cosmos and learn the theory behind it.

courses.title: Foundations of Psychology
courses.description: Ever caught yourself wondering why you’re like this — why you feel the way you feel? Foundations of Psychology breaks down the basics of how the mind works. From perception to personality, it covers the essentials of psychology. If understanding people fascinates you, this is where it begins.

courses.title: Quantum Mechanics and Quantum Computing
courses.description: Explore the fascinating world of quantum mechanics. Understand the ideas Max Planck came up with and the principles Einstein used to win a Nobel Prize — or simply understand why Ant-Man was “trapped” in the Quantum Realm.

courses.title: LinkedIn 101
courses.description: Learn how to present yourself to the world through LinkedIn — the world’s largest professional information network — and how to build the connections that lead you to the perfect job and future.

courses.title: AstroPhysics
courses.description: Dive deep into the mysteries of the universe. Understand the cosmos and start your journey toward groundbreaking research. Grasp the physics and science behind the universe. If the mysteries of the cosmos keep you awake at night, you are at the right spot.

courses.title: Semiconductors
courses.description: The future of humanity depends on the advancement of semiconductor technology. Semiconductors are the foundation of innovation, driving fields such as AI, aerospace, flexible devices, and submarines. Understand why such a small device packs such a massive punch — and why every nation in the world is trying so hard to make it smaller.

courses.title: Molecular Biology and Genetics
courses.description: The Molecular Biology and Genetics masterclass and internship provide in-depth knowledge of microorganisms and essential lab techniques. You'll gain practical experience in culturing, identifying, and analyzing microbes, preparing you for advanced studies or a career in microbiology, biotechnology, or related fields.

courses.title: AI with ML
courses.description: The AI with ML masterclass and internship offer in-depth learning of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts. You'll gain hands-on experience with algorithms, data analysis, and model building, equipping you with practical skills for careers in AI and data science.

intro.heading: Exhibitions and Startups
intro.body: Be a part of something greater. Solve real-world problems using your own skill and understanding — and develop a deeper grasp of whatever subject you’re passionate about.

courses.title: Chess
courses.description: One of the world’s most loved games — with all its rages, sorrows and joys. Experience why people truly love this game, and learn what you should be doing to get better at it.

courses.title: Quizzing
courses.description: Test your brain on everything under the sun — General Knowledge, History, Art, Science, or anything that pleases your heart. Take time out with peers to enjoy this fun (or frustrating!) comic of life in a whole new way.

courses.title: MUN
courses.description: In a Model UN conference, students work as the representatives of a country, organisation, or person, and aim to solve real-world problems together with delegates from around the world. Join us to understand how it works and start your MUN journey.

courses.title: Myths and Quests
courses.description: Ever wondered why Loki was not a god from birth, or why Cleopatra was the last Egyptian ruler? Join us for a fun conversation about mythology, faiths, and the beliefs that shaped the world — and figure it out for yourself.

courses.title: Western Vocals
courses.description: Open your voice — and your mind — to the world of music. Maybe the do-re-mi will satisfy your hunger for melody. If you’re fascinated by the works of Mozart or Hofer, or simply want to learn something new, you are at the right place.

intro.heading: What Makes Us Better?
intro.body: Our mentor base is truly exceptional — each bringing years of valuable experience in their respective fields. They are committed to helping you expand your knowledge and enhance your portfolio in meaningful ways. Through personalised guidance and industry insights, our mentors work closely with you to identify your strengths, address your weaknesses, and develop a tailored plan to achieve your goals. With their support, you’ll gain the confidence and skills you need to excel in your career.

mentors.name: Dev Keerthi P
mentors.role_attribution: Dev Keerthi P, CEO and Mentor - AstroAscend
mentors.bio: A Creator, A Founder, A Scientist. An Intellectual. A student of Theology. These are just a few of the many things that he is and will ever be. Currently studying in RV College of Engineering, driven by curiosity and a deep desire to make an impact through innovation and creativity he creates new projects every year to push humanity to greater good.
mentors.details:
He teaches these topics and has received training from the following institutions:

Astronomy: Trained by Edumithra, IIT Madras (IITM), and Indian Institute of Science (IISC)
Astrophysics: Trained by Star Labs, IIT Madras (IITM), IISC, and BITS Pilani
Quantum Mechanics: Trained at IIT Madras (IITM), BITS Pilani, and IIT Delhi (IITD)
Semiconductors: Trained at IISC Bangalore

Additionally, he has worked on three major projects:
1. AgniSAT: Focused on global warming control
2. V.A.Y.U.D.E.V: Aimed at reducing the need for air conditioning (AC)
3. Mixed VidyuthKosh: Aimed to increase defence capabilities

He is currently working on projects on Semiconductors with IISC and Quantum mechanics with RVCE
mentors.quote: “A mentor is more than just what we see - it is the one who holds your hand and makes sure you reach your destination no matter what”

mentors.name: Krishna Deepti
mentors.bio: This is Krishna Deepti, currently a second-year undergraduate student at CHRIST University, Bangalore, pursuing Psychology and English (Honours), who has been passionate about psychology for many years, with a deep interest in the biological basis of behaviour and the clinical aspects.
mentors.details:
Deepti, with her deep understanding of clinical psychology, leads the Foundations of Psychology course thanks to her work in:

Research Experience – interned at IIIT Sri City; worked for 150+ hours on a study examining the association between psychological disorders and EEG signals.
Training & Certifications – Completed a 2-month psychology training. Certified in Leadership Skill Development and Communication Skill Development through Christ University.
Peer Education & Teaching – Trained Peer Educator through a year-long university program guided by counsellors and psychiatrists.
Social Work – Worked with Need Base India-Rainbow Home, Bangalore. Taught life skills to students from Class 1 to Class 12.

Currently she is conducting mental health and life skills sessions for first-year university students.
mentors.quote: “Studying psychology taught me that behind every behaviour is a story worth understanding.”

mentors.name: Varsha Deepak
mentors.bio: Varsha Deepak is a Western Vocal Instructor with over 15 years of musical experience, trained in both Carnatic and Western vocals. Her journey from classical foundations to Western performance has shaped her disciplined, technique-focused, and confidence-building approach to teaching.
mentors.details:
We're thrilled to announce that Varsha Deepak will be taking charge of our Western Vocals classes and these are her achievements in music.

 Western Vocal Music: Formally trained at Trinity College London with 15 years of singing experience.  
Vocal Technique: Background in Carnatic music and advanced Western techniques, emphasizing breath control, pitch accuracy, and vocal health.  
Performance: Extensive experience in competitions, live events, and studio work.  
Guitar: Trained to provide harmonic and rhythmic support.  

She offers practical experience in:  
1. Vocal Performance: Live shows and competitions.  
2. Studio Work: Recording and Production in professional environments.  
3. Vocal Instruction: Teaching all levels, focusing on technique and building confidence.  

Currently, she teaches Western Vocal Music, using a gentle, technique-focused approach to connect individuals through music.
mentors.quote: “Singing connects me to people beyond words, and through music, I believe we can truly connect with one another.”

mentors.name: Daksh Jain
mentors.bio: Daksh Jain is an accomplished debater and respected MUN leader. As Head of CoMUN 2025, Bangalore’s largest MUN, he delivered record participation and rigorous discourse. Known for clarity, diplomacy, and composed leadership, he consistently excels across conferences, shaping meaningful dialogue while upholding the highest standards of preparation, teamwork, and integrity.
mentors.details:
Daksh is one of the Bengaluru Circuit’s most esteemed MUNners. His debating skills enable him to lead the MUN class effectively.

These are the positions he has held over the last 2 years:
2024 CoMUN UNGA-SSIPC Moderator
2024 IRSMUN AIPPM Co-Chairperson
2025 CoMUN AIPPM Chairperson
2025 Arogi MUN Secretariat Director General
2025 CoMUN OC Head of CoMUN & OC
2025 SMUN AIPPM Co-Chairperson

Each of these highlights his exceptional talent in MUNs and debating. He is currently preparing for several national and international MUNs, both as a chair and as a participant.
mentors.quote: “Where there is power, there is politics, and where there is knowledge, there is the power that shapes it.”

mentors.name: Sanskriti Hooli
mentors.bio: Sanskriti is a Class 11 Commerce student who is interested in business and marketing. Apart from that, she enjoys learning new things, working with new people and taking part in activities that bring about a positive change.
mentors.details:
Sanskriti has participated in multiple leadership and social initiatives:

- 1M1B Future Leaders Program: Represented her project at the United Nations Headquarters.
- Days for Girls: Helped raise ₹45,000 for the initiative and participated in distributing reusable menstrual kits to girls in government schools.
- Extracurricular Activities: Active participant in Model United Nations (MUNs) and theatre activities.
mentors.quote: “The only way to do great work is to love what you do” - Steve Jobs

options.title: Join As a Mentor
options.body: The future of Earth depends on how many people we train today as the flag bearers of tomorrow — and the most important part of that is the mentor. If you believe you have what it takes to be a mentor, join us on this journey to make the world a better place.

options.title: Join As a Donor
options.body: If you love what we do and would like to be more closely involved with AstroAscend, consider donating — and we’ll make sure you really understand what we do. (Shh… there’s something special in it for you if you donate.)

options.title: Join As an Ideator
options.body: Have ideas on how we can make AstroAscend better — or just make anything more appealing in general? Join us today and create change in your own way.

options.title: Join As a Challenger
options.body: Have a skill? Want to take it to the next level? Join us as a Challenger and get the chance to compete at the highest levels — IITs, IIMs, international competitions, and many more.

options.title: Join As a Sustainer
options.body: The Earth is dying, and it falls to us today to protect it. For too long we have been part of the problem — let us now be part of the solution, and tip the scales to preserve Mother Earth and every species on it. Join us and take the pledge today, before it becomes too late.

documents.title: View Our Public Documents
documents.body: Browse our publicly available documents to better understand how we work.

footer.tagline: The place of knowledge — redesigned to suit and upskill your needs — now has a new name: AstroAscend. For science, commerce, culture, or anything in between.
